The viewer observes a dense web of interwoven filaments that cross and overlap in a complex pattern, with faint luminous pulses traveling steadily along the glass strands. The visual effect captures both the fragility of the glass components and the robustness of the metallic infrastructure, creating an abstract representation of digital connectivity at a microscopic scale.
